scenario: 今日具身智能这一侧，同时在问：怎样用更少的真机数据，让技能在不同机器人之间搬得动，在接触和协调上更靠得住。有的工作从一条真实演示重建可验证的世界，再改写技能代码，部署时不再调用大模型。有的在中间训练里补上低层行为覆盖，好让策略在加长执行和在线更新时更有用。还有的让一个策略直接看当前机器人的运动学，或把第一人称人类视频变成人形训练数据。双手操作开始在同一时刻为两臂分设动作表示，几何也可以先外给、只学执行。世界模型和视觉潜变量则分别从跨形态运动和场景如何演化入手。触觉仿真把法向和切向力做得更一致，小型足式机器人可以把避障收成对既有步行策略速度指令的修正。

papers.title: RESET: One Demonstration, One Verified World, Self-Improved Skills Across Embodiments
papers.authors: Zheng Sun, Zhuo Li, Zhihao Li, Hengyi Sim, Ge Wang, Ziyue Zhu, Mingkai Jia, Fei Chen
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents can iteratively self-improve robot manipulation skills in simulation benchmarks, yet real-world tasks provide neither ground-truth success scorers nor resettable practice environments. Our key observation is that a single real demonstration simultaneously specifies scene geometry, defines the terminal success criterion, and serves as a physical reference trajectory for verifying world fidelity---all decoupled from the source robot's kinematics. We present {RESET}: we reconstruct a contact-rich world and derive a frozen read-only criterion from one demonstration ({R}ebuild); check that world against the demonstration by open-loop replay and silhouette consistency ({E}xamine); evolve modular white-box task graphs and skill code from per-node failure evidence ({S}elf-improve); deploy frozen code on real robots with zero runtime LLM calls ({E}xecute); and share the verified world and criterion with unseen robots without new demonstrations ({T}ransfer). On 8 manipulation tasks, each rebuilt from one real demonstration, RESET achieves 97% average success on unseen layouts in simulation, whereas zero-shot code reaches 27%, per-task fine-tuned pi0.5 policies 31%, and Diffusion Policy 50%; injecting reconstruction defects shows that practice tolerates many reconstruction errors, that geometric errors can still stall or mislead it, and that the check flags most of them while physical randomization covers the rest. Without any target demonstrations, 3 heterogeneous robots acquire the same task skills in the shared world: a robot with similar arms copies 95% of its skill functions unchanged from the source robot, while robots with different arms and hands write their own. In real-robot experiments, the resulting programs run on 4 robots and succeed in 80% of 280 trials.
papers.summary: 大模型编程智能体可以在仿真基准里反复改机器人操作技能，可真机任务既没有现成的成功评分器，也没有可随意复位的练习环境。一次真实演示其实同时给出了场景几何、终点成功标准和检验世界是否忠实的物理参考轨迹，而且这些都不依赖于源机器人的运动学。RESET 从这一条演示重建可接触的世界和只读的成功标准，用开环回放和轮廓一致性做检查，再按节点上的失败证据改写模块化任务图和技能代码，部署时不再调用大模型。在八项操作任务上，仿真里未见过的布局平均成功率为 97%，零样本代码只有 27%。得到的程序在四台真机、280 次试验里成功 80%。没有目标机演示时，结构相近的手臂还能直接复用大部分技能函数。

papers.title: Exploratory Midtraining for Robot Policies
papers.authors: Kshitiz, Zheyuan Hu, Robyn Wu, Yizhou Li, Yunchu Zhang, Vattanary Tevy, Kavya Tayal, Shawn Yin, Aykut Onol, Kushal Arora, Dhruv Shah, Abhishek Gupta, Zackory Erickson, Aviral Kumar
papers.abstract: Robot policies predominantly learn from human-collected data emphasizing competent behavior, limiting coverage of the low-level behaviors needed to support autonomous improvement. We study how a form of midtraining can be used to build coverage over diverse low-level behaviors that connect challenging states of the robot and its environment to states from which further progress is possible ("connected behavioral coverage"). We also examine how this coverage supports downstream adaptation and online improvement. To this end, we introduce $\beta$-Data, a dataset collected via adversarial teleoperation, where a human adversary reversibly perturbs the environment while a human operator continues toward completion without resetting. We relabel trajectory segments with local outcomes in natural language and finetune a pretrained policy conditioned on recent action history. The resulting policy exhibits sustained use of more low-level behaviors. Across manipulation tasks in simulation and on three real-robot platforms, our approach yields more favorable data scaling laws, better zero-shot generalization, and more effective use of additional rollout time than training on standard demonstrations. During online finetuning, these policies need fewer rollouts to collect successful experience and reach higher success rates, suggesting that midtraining can prepare robots for both more robust task execution and continued autonomous improvement. Our project page and robot videos are available at https://kshitiz-1225.github.io/exploratory-midtraining-robot-policies/.
papers.summary: 机器人策略多半只从强调顺利完成的人类演示里学，低层行为覆盖往往不够，后面想自己改进时就会缺连接。一种中间训练可以补上这些低层行为，把机器人和环境里的困难状态，重新连回还能继续推进的状态。数据来自对抗式遥操作：一人可逆地扰动环境，另一人继续把任务做完，并不复位，再为轨迹片段补上自然语言的局部结果。在仿真和三台真机上，这样得到的策略比用标准演示训练更经得起数据放大，零样本泛化更好，也能更有效地利用加长的执行时间。在仿真打包任务里，成功率从用标准演示时的 54.7% 提高到 69.7%。只用 2.6 小时这类数据，成功率就能达到 60.3%，相当于用两倍时长的标准演示。

papers.title: OmniAct: One Policy, One Million Embodiments
papers.authors: Xiang Fan, Yuheng Wang, Jiayuan Yan, Bohan Fang, Wisdom Oluchi Ikezogwo, Ainaz Eftekhar, Max Argus, Jason Ren, Jiafei Duan, Ranjay Krishna
papers.abstract: A single policy that controls diverse robots must not only transfer task knowledge across embodiments, but also adapt its behavior to each robot's capabilities. Existing approaches facilitate transfer through shared action representations, but these representations do not necessarily capture how differences in robot morphology should shape manipulation strategies. We introduce OmniAct, a cross-embodiment manipulation policy that conditions directly on each robot's kinematics in a specific scene to produce embodiment-specific behavior. This kinematic graph represents the robot's joint positions, motion axes, and connectivity to its visual observation, allowing the policy to account for how its embodiment related to objects and surfaces in the scene. A flow-matching policy predicts relative joint motions for each node, enabling control across robots with different degrees of freedom and kinematic configurations. To learn how physical structure shapes behavior at scale, we procedurally design and filter one million physically feasible robot embodiments; next, we develop algorithms to generate robot trajectories in simulation for all embodiments; finally, we train across diverse simulated manipulation tasks. On 2,000 embodiment-scene-held-out evaluation episodes, OmniAct achieves 63.0% success, compared to 17.8% for pi 0.5 and 57.9% for the strongest baseline; on the task families GPT-6 Astra was evaluated on, it achieves 64.7% against GPT-6 Astra's 41.1%. On a previously unseen real-world robot, it achieves nearly twice the success rate of the next best method, MolmoAct2. Beyond task success, we observe that OmniAct learns distinct manipulation strategies that exploit the capabilities and accommodate the limitations of different morphologies. Project: https://omniact.github.io/
papers.summary: 一个策略要控制形态各异的机器人，不但得迁移任务知识，还得按每台机器在当前场景里的能力来调整做法。已有方法常用共享动作表示来迁移，却不一定能说明形态差异该如何改变操作策略。OmniAct 直接把机器人在该场景中的运动学图作为条件，图里包含关节位置、运动轴，以及它们与视觉观察的连接，再预测各节点的相对关节运动。作者程序化设计并筛选出一百万个物理上可行的机器人形态，在仿真里为它们生成轨迹并做多样化操作训练。在两千个留出形态和场景的评测回合里，成功率为 63.0%，pi0.5 只有 17.8%。在 GPT-6 Astra 评过的任务族上，它达到 64.7%，对方为 41.1%。在一台先前未见过的真机上，成功率也接近下一方法的两倍。

papers.title: EgoLoAF: Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Egocentric Demonstrations with Hand-Object Affordances
papers.authors: Yiming Zeng, Jiangyuxuan Dai, Yuheng Na, Tan Zhu Xuan, Zihan Lin, Xinfang Qi, Shijian Zhang, Chengqi Shi, Yihan Kuang, Zhide Zhong, Junjie He, Junfeng Li, Zimu Han, Naipeng Li, Haoang Li
papers.abstract: Training humanoid vision-language-action (VLA) models relies heavily on costly real-robot teleoperation. Recent efforts convert egocentric human demonstrations into humanoid training data. However, most methods still require wearable motion trackers and leave important hand-object interaction cues implicit. Many also mix in real-robot teleoperation data for VLA post-training. These dependencies limit scalable data collection, while implicit interaction cues make precise contact harder to learn. To overcome these limitations, we propose EgoLoAF, the first paradigm to derive all training data for humanoid loco-manipulation directly from egocentric demonstrations without wearable motion trackers. We post-train the VLA on the converted data alone, without real-robot teleoperation demonstrations, and use explicit hand-object interaction cues to guide action generation. Specifically, to obtain humanoid action targets, we estimate torso motion from recorded camera poses and reconstruct both hand trajectories from video. From the same recording, we use each hand's current pose relative to the object to represent hand-object affordances. During post-training, we inject these affordances into the action expert through cross-attention while keeping the vision-language backbone frozen. Additionally, we release 128,400 egocentric demonstration episodes spanning 1,000 hours and 1,284 tasks, together with converted humanoid action trajectories and rendered robot-view observations. Across four real-world tasks, EgoLoAF nearly achieves teleoperation performance (73.1 vs. 74.4 in mean Task Progress Score), while achieving a mean 4.03 times improvement in data-collection efficiency.
papers.summary: 训练人形机器人的视觉-语言-动作模型，通常要靠昂贵的真机遥操作。把第一人称人类演示转成训练数据，往往还得戴动作捕捉设备，手和物体的接触线索也被写得很隐，不少方法在后训练里仍要混入真机遥操作。EgoLoAF 的全部训练数据都来自第一人称演示，不使用可穿戴动作捕捉，后训练也不再加入真机遥操作演示，并用显式的手物关系来引导动作生成。它从相机位姿估计躯干运动，从视频重建双手轨迹，再用手相对物体的当前位姿表示手物关系，经交叉注意力注入动作专家，同时冻结视觉-语言骨干。作者还发布了十多万条、一千小时的第一人称演示。在四项真机任务上，平均任务进度达到 73.1，接近遥操作的 74.4，采集效率约提高 4.03 倍。

papers.title: Duo: Towards Spatiotemporal Action Coordination in Bimanual Policies
papers.authors: Zhimu Zhou, Yuqi Yang, Yixin Lin, Junsen Zhang, Jian Zhao, Jiayu Zhong, Jiaxun Sun, Bingxin Wang, Binhua Zuo, Bo Zhao
papers.abstract: Bimanual manipulation requires each arm to perform distinct motions while coordinating with the other. Common flow-based robotic policies combine both arms' actions into one token per future timestep, giving attention distinct positions across time but not across arms. We introduce Duo, a simple but effective design that models spatial and temporal dependencies within one shared action head. Specifically, Duo separates both arms into two action tokens per timestep, allowing each arm's motion to interact via cross-arm attention during flow matching. On RoboTwin 2.0, Duo improves the overall success of all four base policies, from 0.45B to 3.62B parameters, with gains of 12.55 and 9.02 percentage points for FLOWER (0.89B) and $\pi_{0.5}$ (3.62B), respectively. Despite its compact size, FLOWER-Duo achieves the best randomized-generalization, precision, and memory scores on RoboDojo. In real-world tasks, it outperforms $\pi_{0.5}$ in both success rate and execution speed, while scaling effectively with increasing training data. To provide deeper insight into the design of Duo, we conduct systematic ablations on inter-arm coordination, action grouping, and token granularity, confirming that cross-arm attention drives the improvement while arm-wise interaction offers the best accuracy-compute trade-off.
papers.summary: 双手操作要求两只手臂各走各的动作，又要彼此配合。常见的基于流的机器人策略，会把两只手臂在同一未来时刻的动作收成一个 token，注意力能区分不同时刻，却不能直接区分左右臂。Duo 在同一个共享动作头里同时建模空间和时间依赖，把每个时刻拆成两个动作 token，让两臂在流匹配时通过跨臂注意力相互作用。在 RoboTwin 2.0 上，它对从约四亿五千万到三十六亿参数的四种基础策略都提高了总体成功率，其中 FLOWER 提高 12.55 个百分点，pi0.5 提高 9.02 个百分点。尽管模型并不大，FLOWER-Duo 还在随机泛化、精度和记忆等指标上取得最好成绩。真机任务里，它在成功率和执行速度上也超过 pi0.5，并随训练数据增加而继续提升。

papers.title: Supply Geometry, Learn Execution: Screw Attention for Zero-Shot Policy Transfer in Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: We present the Screw Attention Policy, a geometry-centric manipulation framework that supplies task geometry explicitly and learns only execution. The policy operates on object poses, relative SE(3) transforms, and joint screw axes provided by perception and robot models. The policy requires only 30K learned parameters. Trained entirely in simulation on a single robot arm, the policy generalises to new scene layouts, transfers zero-shot across robot embodiments, and deploys directly on a real robot, without adaptation or fine-tuning. It achieves 96% success on LIBERO, 85.8% under layout changes, 80.2% across five unseen robot arms, and 21 of 24 trials on a real robot. These results suggest that much of what manipulation policies learn at scale is geometric structure that can instead be supplied.
papers.summary: 操作策略在大规模训练里，常常把几何结构也一起学进去，换场景或换机器人时就要重新适应。Screw Attention 把任务几何明确提供出来，只让模型学习如何执行。它使用感知给出的物体位姿、相对位姿变换，以及机器人模型提供的关节螺旋轴，可学习参数只有约三万个。策略完全在仿真里、在单臂上训练，却能泛化到新的场景布局，零样本转到其他机器人形态，并直接部署到真机，不必再适应或微调。它在 LIBERO 上成功率为 96%，布局变化时为 85.8%，在五个未见过的机器人手臂上为 80.2%，真机二十四次试验里成功二十一次。这说明许多规模化训练里学到的，其实是本来可以外给的几何结构。

papers.title: DexLatentWorld: 3D Cross-Embodiment Latent Action World Models for Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: World models facilitate planning and control in robotic manipulation by enabling agents to anticipate the consequences of their actions. However, they typically rely on action-labelled interaction data that is costly to acquire and difficult to scale. These models are also often tied to the specific embodiment they were trained on, limiting transferability to previously unseen robot morphologies. We introduce a 3D latent-action world model that learns continuous action representations directly from point-cloud observations of retargeted human manipulation demonstrations. A contrastive objective is used to encourage consistent representations of motion across embodiments. The resulting unified latent action space serves directly as the search space for model-predictive control, where sampled latent actions condition particle-based future predictions. Executable robot commands are then recovered from the predicted geometric motion without requiring an embodiment-specific action decoder. Through extensive evaluations, we demonstrate that the learned latent actions exhibit controllable and compositional motion, transfer to unseen robot embodiments, and support zero-shot manipulation with unseen gripper geometries. Following task-agnostic adaptation, our model achieves 90%, 92%, and 60% success on reaching, grasping, and placing, respectively, compared with DexWM's reported 72%, 58%, and 28%. Finally, we demonstrate zero-shot real-world manipulation with an unseen dexterous hand, achieving an 86% success rate across 50 trials on five diverse tasks involving pushing, grasping, and lifting everyday objects. These results highlight the potential of geometry-grounded latent actions as a unified, transferable interface for world-model-based robotic manipulation. Project materials, including demonstration videos and source code, are available at https://vinaymohan0409.github.io.
papers.authors: Vinay Udit Mohan, Xuchuan Huang, Rolandos Alexandros Potamias
papers.summary: 世界模型能让机器人预见到动作的后果，可它们通常依赖带动作标注的交互数据，既贵也难扩展，还往往绑在训练时的那一种形态上。新的三维潜在动作世界模型，直接从重定向后的人类操作点云里学习连续的动作表示，并用对比目标让不同形态下的同一运动保持一致。预测出的几何运动可以直接还原成可执行指令，不必再为每种机器人单独准备动作解码器。经与任务无关的适应之后，够取、抓住和放下的成功率分别为 90%、92% 和 60%，明显高于先前世界模型。它还能零样本转到未见过的夹爪几何。在一只未见过的灵巧手上，五类推、抓、举的日常物体任务里，五十次试验的成功率为 86%。

papers.title: ViTacLab: Physically Consistent Visuo-Tactile Simulation, Benchmarking, and Representation Learning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Linjing You, Zeming Yang, Zhenhao Shen, Shengqiang Xu, Guanda Li, Wenxuan Li, Jiyu Guo, Jasper Lu, Kyle Xu, Shawn Xie, Junjie Zhu, Siyu Wu, Jian Liu, Changhao Zhang, Rongchong Li, Zeyi Li, Hengshuang Zhao, Ruihai Wu
papers.abstract: Tactile sensing is essential for contact-rich robotic manipulation, but existing visuo-tactile simulators trade physical fidelity for scalability, and benchmarks largely focus on two-finger grippers. We present ViTacLab, a framework comprising ViTacSim, ViTacBench, and ViTacPolicy. ViTacSim uses a tri-modal tactile primitive: a global sparse contact-force lattice, a local dense force array, and tactile images. Anchored to PhysX contact-solver outputs, it corrects normal inconsistency through local stiffness alignment and reconstructs tangential forces under decoupled slip-stick regimes while preserving GPU parallelism. A joint projection preserves the sparse wrench and enforces local friction cones. ViTacBench spans parallel grippers, dexterous hands, and bimanual systems, with tasks ranging from vision-dominant to tactile-dominant regimes. ViTacPolicy aggregates variable numbers of heterogeneous tactile inputs using spatial-pose embeddings and a Transformer, and aligns force-array and tactile-image modalities through a two-stream VQ-VAE with a shared codebook. Controlled Hertzian-reference indentation and real-sensor sliding tests reduce normal and tangential force RMSE from 2.31 and 1.85 N to 0.42 and 0.53 N, respectively. Throughput reaches 2,482.9 tactile-pipeline FPS at 256 parallel environments. Simulation and real-world experiments show gains on several contact-rich tasks, while low absolute success on tactile-dominant tasks highlights the remaining difficulty of purely tactile control.
papers.summary: 接触丰富的操作离不开触觉，可现有的视觉-触觉仿真常要在物理保真和规模之间取舍，评测也多半只盯着两指夹爪。ViTacLab 给出一套仿真、基准和策略框架。仿真用三种触觉原语，并把结果锚定在 PhysX 接触求解上，校正法向不一致，再在分离的滑移和黏着状态下重建切向力，同时保住 GPU 并行。基准覆盖平行夹爪、灵巧手和双臂，任务从偏视觉到偏触觉。策略用空间位姿编码和 Transformer 汇总数量可变的异构触觉输入。对照赫兹压痕和真实传感器滑动，法向力均方根误差从 2.31 牛降到 0.42 牛。切向力从 1.85 牛降到 0.53 牛。触觉流水线在二百五十六个并行环境里可达两千多帧每秒。接触丰富的任务有提升，但纯触觉控制的绝对成功率仍然偏低。

papers.title: More Than Picturing the Future: Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning for Generalizable Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Latent reasoning lets Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models deliberate at a fraction of the cost of explicit chain-of-thought, increasingly through visual foresight, which we show to be indispensable for predicting actions. Yet this paradigm is inherited from Vision-Language Models, where it serves understanding rather than action: each latent is aligned with an isolated future frame, often enriched with further modalities of that frame. We find that this binds the policy to the appearance of its training scenes, so that it degrades sharply once the scene changes. We argue that visual latents for action should capture not what a future frame looks like, but how the scene evolves toward the goal. We therefore propose Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning, which redirects visual latents from the whole frame to the interaction that the action must bring about. Semantic latents, following the stages of embodied chain-of-thought, first establish what to accomplish and how. Conditioned on them, motion-oriented latents anticipate each future step from coarse to fine: from the global scene, to the interaction region spanned by the manipulated object and its destination, to the robot state. Relative to the state-of-the-art latent VLA LaST$_0$, our method raises the mean success rate on SimplerEnv-WidowX from 37.5% to 55.2% in distribution and from 22.4% to 30.2% under out-of-distribution shifts, and on an AgileX Piper dual-arm platform from 60.8% to 90.8% in training scenes and from 6.7% to 37.5% under environmental changes.
papers.authors: Xin Zhang, Yushuo Hou, Anqi Zhao, Moyun Liu, Xingwei Zhao, Bo Tao, Jiawei Du, Joey Tianyi Zhou
papers.summary: 潜在推理能让视觉-语言-动作模型在远低于显式思维链的代价下先想一步，而且对预测动作很关键。可这种做法常从视觉语言模型里沿用过来：每个潜变量对齐的是某一帧未来画面，于是策略会被训练场景的外观绑住，场景一变就明显变差。动作所需的视觉潜变量不该只描绘未来看起来像什么，而该抓住场景如何朝目标演化。新方法先用语义潜变量确定要完成什么、怎么做，再让面向运动的潜变量由粗到细预见每一步：从全局场景，到被操作物体与目标之间的交互区域，再到机器人状态。在 AgileX Piper 双臂平台上，训练场景里的平均成功率从 60.8% 提高到 90.8%。环境一变，则从 6.7% 提高到 37.5%。仿真里分布内和分布外的成功率也一齐提高。

papers.title: Microduck Obstacle Avoidance: A Sim2Real Workflow with Isaac Lab and Newton
papers.authors: Oluwaseun Doherty, Oyindamola Omotuyi, Richard AntRi31
papers.abstract: Add local obstacle avoidance to Microduck while keeping its walking policy fixed. Build varied courses with reusable SimReady assets, model ToF sensing with Newton’s raycaster, and train a controller in Isaac Lab to adjust gamepad velocity commands around obstacles. This tutorial covers simulation training, evaluation, export, and real-robot deployment.
papers.summary: 给小型足式机器人加局部避障时，常常不希望改已经训好的步行策略，以免把步态本身训坏。这篇教程在保持 Microduck 步行策略不变的前提下，另训一个控制器，只调整手柄给出的速度指令，让机器人绕开障碍。多样化的赛道由可复用的仿真资产搭建，飞行时间传感则用 Newton 的射线投射来建模，控制器在 Isaac Lab 里训练。流程覆盖仿真训练、评测、导出和真机部署，从而给出一条从仿真到真机的避障工作流。因为步行策略保持固定，避障被收成对速度指令的修正，而不是再训一个全新的行走模型。这样可以把避障作为一层独立的控制，叠在已经可用的步行策略之上，而不必把步态和绕障重新绑在一起训练。
